headlines.shortLinkText: Luzardo strikes out 12 in 1st career shutout, Schwarber homers as Phillies beat Braves 1-0

events.name: New York Mets at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Rookie A.J. Ewing had three hits and drove in three runs as the New York Mets beat the Miami Marlins 9-4 on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie A.J. Ewing's 3 hits, 3 RBI lifts Mets to 9-4 win over Marlins

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Adley Rutschman hit a three-run homer off the Pesky Pole in right field, Brayan Bello pitched five scoreless innings in his first start since early June and the Boston Red Sox beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-2 on Monday for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adley Rutschman's three-run HR off Pesky Pole carries Red Sox past Angels, 5-2

headlines.description: — Trevor Rogers pitched into the eighth inning, Coby Mayo homered twice and the Baltimore Orioles took advantage of Cleveland's wildness on the mound, beating the Guardians 6-4 on Monday to snap a six-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rogers and Mayo help the Orioles snap their 6-game skid with a 6-4 win over Cleveland

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Arizona's Lars Nootbaar had a pinch-hit sacrifice fly in the top of the 10th inning then the Diamondbacks followed with four more runs and held on for a 5-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scoreless through 9 innings, Arizona plates 5 in the 10th, holds on to beat Kansas City 5-4

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio singled home two runs to spark a three-run rally in the eighth inning and made a diving catch for the final out in the ninth as the Milwaukee Brewers came from behind to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers rally in 8th and hold off comeback attempt in 9th for 4-3 win over Cubs

headlines.description: — Riley Greene had three hits, including a two-run homer, and Kevin McGonigle added a solo shot Monday to lead the Detroit Tigers to a 5-4 victory over the Minnesota Twins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Riley Greene and Kevin McGonigle belt home runs for Tigers in 5-4 win over Twins

events.name: Washington Nationals at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Nick Pivetta pitched five shutout innings in his return from a long stay on the injured list and the San Diego Padres beat the skidding Washington Nationals 3-2 on Monday to keep pace in the National League playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Pivetta throws 5 shutout innings in return from injured list as Padres beat Nationals 3-2

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Shay Whitcomb chopped a single with one out in the 11th inning for his first career game-ending RBI, and the San Francisco Giants beat the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shay Whitcomb chops a single in 11th for 1st career game-ending RBI as Giants beat Cardinals 5-4

headlines.description: — Teoscar Hernández hit a three-run homer, Emmet Sheehan tied a career high with 10 strikeouts in his first major league outing since Aug. 2 and the Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Cincinnati Reds 6-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hernández’s 3-run homer and Sheehan’s 10 Ks power Dodgers past Reds 6-3 for 5th straight win

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Jeff McNeil legged out an infield single to drive in the winning run in the bottom of the ninth inning and the Athletics beat the Toronto Blue Jays 6-5 on Monday night after blowing a four-run lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeff McNeil legs out winning single, lifts A's to 6-5 victory over Blue Jays
